ar: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
tr: Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqeem.
en: Guide us along the straight path.
note: Recited in every unit of the daily prayer.

ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
tr: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
tr: Rabbana taqabbal minna, innaka antas-Sami'ul-'Alim.
en: Our Lord, accept this from us. You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
note: Prophets Ibrahim and Ismail, while raising the foundations of the Kaʿbah.

ar: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
tr: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka, wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna, innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
en: Our Lord, make us devoted to You, and raise from our descendants a community devoted to You. Show us how to worship, and turn to us in mercy. You are the Ever-Accepting of repentance, the Most Merciful.
note: Prophets Ibrahim and Ismail.

ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
tr: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
en: Our Lord, pour patience over us, keep our feet firm, and help us against those who reject the truth.
note: The believers with Talut, as they faced Jalut (Goliath).

ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
tr: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih. Wa'fu 'anna, waghfir lana, warhamna. Anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
en: Our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not lay on us a burden like the one You laid on those before us. Our Lord, do not make us carry what we have no strength for. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against those who reject the truth.
note: The closing verse of Surah Al-Baqarah.

ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
tr: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana, wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab.
en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts turn away after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. You are the Ever-Giving.
note: The prayer of those firmly grounded in knowledge.

ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
tr: Rabbana innana amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
en: Our Lord, we believe, so forgive our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
note: The prayer of the mindful believers.

ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
tr: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka Sami'ud-du'a.
en: My Lord, grant me, from Yourself, good children. You are the Hearer of every prayer.
note: Prophet Zakariyya, asking for a child.

ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
tr: Rabbanaghfir lana dhunubana wa israfana fi amrina, wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
en: Our Lord, forgive our sins and our excesses in our affairs, keep our feet firm, and help us against those who reject the truth.
note: The faithful followers of earlier prophets in times of hardship.

ar: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
tr: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batila, subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar.
en: Our Lord, You did not create all this without purpose. Glory be to You. Protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
note: Those who reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth.

ar: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
tr: Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar.
en: Our Lord, forgive our sins, wipe away our wrongdoings, and let us die among the righteous.

ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
tr: Rabbana zalamna anfusana, wa il-lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.
note: Adam and Hawwa, after their mistake.

ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
tr: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa tawaffana muslimin.
en: Our Lord, pour patience over us and take our souls while we are in submission to You.
note: The magicians who believed in Musa, under Pharaoh's threats.

ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
tr: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim.
en: Allah is enough for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is Lord of the Mighty Throne.

ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
tr: Rabbij'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a.
en: My Lord, make me one who keeps up the prayer, and my children too. Our Lord, accept my prayer.
note: Prophet Ibrahim.

ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
tr: Rabbanaghfir li wa li-walidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
en: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the reckoning is established.
note: Prophet Ibrahim.

ar: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
tr: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.
en: My Lord, have mercy on them both, as they raised me when I was small.
note: For one's parents.

ar: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
tr: Rabbi adkhilni mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijni mukhraja sidqin, waj'al li min ladunka sultanan nasira.
en: My Lord, let me enter in a truthful way and leave in a truthful way, and grant me from Yourself a supporting power.
note: For a sincere start and finish to any undertaking.

ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
tr: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada.
en: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself, and prepare for us right guidance in our situation.
note: The young men who took refuge in the cave.

ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
tr: Rabbishrah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
en: My Lord, open up my heart for me, make my task easy, and untie the knot in my tongue so that they understand my words.
note: Prophet Musa, when sent to Pharaoh. Often recited before speaking, studying, or exams.

ar: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
tr: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.
en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

ar: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
tr: Anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin.
en: Hardship has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.
note: Prophet Ayyub (Job), in his illness and loss.

ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
tr: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
en: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I have truly been among the wrongdoers.
note: Prophet Yunus (Jonah), from the darkness of the whale.

ar: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
tr: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayrul-munzilin.
en: My Lord, let me land in a blessed place. You are the best of those who bring to a safe landing.
note: Prophet Nuh, on settling in the ark. Often recited when arriving somewhere new.

ar: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
tr: Rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin, wa a'udhu bika Rabbi ay yahduroon.
en: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their being near me.

ar: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
tr: Rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimin.
en: My Lord, forgive and have mercy. You are the best of those who show mercy.

ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
tr: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.
en: Our Lord, grant us spouses and children who are a joy to our eyes, and make us a good example for those mindful of You.
note: A description of the servants of the Most Merciful.

ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
tr: Rabbi hab li hukman wa alhiqni bis-salihin.
en: My Lord, grant me sound judgment and join me with the righteous.
note: Prophet Ibrahim.

ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
tr: Rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li.
en: My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.
note: Prophet Musa.

ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
tr: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
en: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
note: Prophet Musa, alone and tired after arriving in Madyan.

ar: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
tr: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya, wa an a'mala salihan tardahu, wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimin.
en: My Lord, inspire me to be thankful for the blessings You gave me and my parents, to do good that pleases You, and to make my children righteous. I turn to You in repentance, and I am among those who submit.
note: For one who has reached maturity.

ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
tr: Rabbanaghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-iman, wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu, Rabbana innaka Ra'ufur-Rahim.
en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers and sisters who came before us in faith, and do not let any bitterness toward the believers settle in our hearts. Our Lord, You are Kind and Merciful.
note: Those who came after the first believers.

ar: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tr: Rabbana atmim lana nurana waghfir lana, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
en: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us. You have power over all things.
note: The believers on the Day of Judgment.

ar: وَالضُّحَىٰ ﴿١﴾ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ ﴿٢﴾ مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ ﴿٤﴾ وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ ﴿٥﴾ أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ ﴿٦﴾ وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ ﴿٧﴾ وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ ﴿٨﴾ فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ ﴿٩﴾ وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ ﴿١٠﴾ وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ ﴿١١﴾
tr: Wad-duha. Wal-layli idha saja. Ma wadda'aka Rabbuka wa ma qala. Wa lal-akhiratu khayrul-laka minal-ula. Wa lasawfa yu'tika Rabbuka fatarda. Alam yajidka yatiman fa-awa. Wa wajadaka dallan fahada. Wa wajadaka 'a'ilan fa-aghna. Fa-amma-l-yatima fala taqhar. Wa amma-s-sa'ila fala tanhar. Wa amma bi-ni'mati Rabbika fahaddith.
en: By the morning brightness, and by the night when it grows still, your Lord has not abandoned you, nor is He displeased. The Hereafter will surely be better for you than this life. Your Lord will soon give you so much that you will be well pleased. Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter? Did He not find you lost and guide you? Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient? So do not oppress the orphan, do not turn away the one who asks, and speak about your Lord's blessings.
note: Surah Ad-Duha, a short surah of reassurance from the last part of the Qur'an.

ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
tr: Fasabbih bihamdi Rabbika wastaghfirh, innahu kana Tawwaba.
en: Glorify your Lord with praise and ask His forgiveness. He is always ready to accept repentance.

ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
tr: Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the harm of what He has created, from the harm of the darkness when it settles, from the harm of those who blow on knots, and from the harm of the envier when he envies.
note: A prayer for seeking refuge in Allah.

ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
tr: Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of people, the Sovereign of people, the God of people, from the harm of the whisperer who slips away, who whispers in the hearts of people, from among jinn and people.
note: The final surah of the Qur'an, a prayer for seeking refuge in Allah.
